summary: First Phosphate Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the SEC under Form 6-K, furnished its Annual Information Form for the year ended February 28, 2026, together with CEO and CFO certifications, dated October 29, 2026. The AIF is a routine Canadian annual disclosure document covering mineral projects (Bégin-Lamarche, Lac à l'Orignal), capital structure, escrowed securities, directors and officers, risk factors, material contracts, audit committee matters and auditor fees. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is disclosed; this is ordinary annual reporting, not a special situation. What to watch: subsequent NI 43-101 technical updates and any future financings.
